CURRENT SCENE:
孟子想，难怪我们常常搬家，原来我妈妈很忙。可是常常搬家害得孟子很难找到朋友。每次搬家孟子也觉得新的地方不是太热就是太冷，不是太大就是太小。在哪的地方，他都不高兴。孟子想帮助妈妈祭拜，可是他六岁，所以不能祭拜。

ITEMS:

[I78] 每次搬家孟子【也】觉得新的地方不是太热就是太冷   correction: 也 → 都   strength: suggestion
  rule card (purpose_weile, Coherence: connectors): Use 为了 + VP. to state a purpose, usually before the main clause. Do not use 为了 as a result connector, and do not put the 为了 phrase in the latter clause.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <purpose> is the purpose of <main action>, so use 为了 + <VP> before the main clause; do not use 所以 to show a result here.  Her terms: 为了 + VP.
  her past correction: 他们搬家不是为了孟母[-要]住在更好的房子 — her note: 为了 + VP.
  her past correction: 他们搬家不是为了[-孟母]要住在更好的房子 — her note: delete孟母
  her past correction: [-他们]搬家每次学到了比较多

[I79] 不是【太】大就是太小   correction: 太 → (delete)   strength: error
  rule card (near_synonym_precision, Vocabulary): Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <correct> because it means <intended meaning/context>; <wrong> is used for <different meaning/context>.  Her terms: 了completed
  her past correction: 你就[太→那么]淘气了
  her past correction: [-比方说] — her note: 比方说is used to express “for example”, delete it
  her past correction: [-他]就不会成为好的大人 — her note: redundant

[I80] 不是太大就是【太】小   correction: 太 → (delete)   strength: error
  rule card (example_emphasis_connectors, Coherence: connectors): 比方说 introduces a following example; delete it when no example follows. 特别是+N, + Clause singles out a typical example, so N must be an example of the category.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <比方说> needs a following example, or <特别是+N, + Clause> must single out an N that is a typical example of <category>.  Her terms: 比方说, 特别是+N, + Clause
  her past correction: [-比方说] — her note: 比方说is used to express “for example”, delete it
  her past correction: 你就[太→那么]淘气了
  her past correction: 他问[-了] — her note: no了for speaking word introducing quoted speech

[I81] 在【哪】的地方   correction: 哪 → 哪个   strength: error
  checker's note: “在哪个地方” is the grammatical phrase.
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 小孟[在→在哪儿？]
  her past correction: 在第一个[房子→地方]
  her past correction: 在[第三个房子→第三个地方]

[I82] 可是他【^】六岁   correction: ∅ → 只有   strength: suggestion
  rule card (adversative_connector, Coherence: connectors): Use 可是, 却, 而, and 但 only when there is a real “semantic turn,” such as a contrast or an unexpected result. 却 indicates an unexpected semantic turn.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: there is no real contrast or “semantic turn” here, so do not use <connector>.  Her terms: semantic turn
  her past correction: 他才三岁[+，可是一直]的以后待在墓地里
  her past correction: 他才四[-年]岁
  her past correction: 他有的时候[-只要]跟朋友玩儿 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿

items.explanation: It would be more natural to use 都 with 每次. 每次搬家 means “every time they moved,” so use 都 to show that this feeling happened each time.
Use 不是大就是小 here. 太 means “too/excessively,” but the sentence is simply contrasting whether the place was big or small.
Use 不是大就是小 here. 太 means “too/excessively,” but the sentence is simply contrasting whether the place was big or small.
哪 does not normally go directly before 地方 in this phrase. Use 哪个地方 instead.
It would be more natural to say 可是他只有六岁. 只有 emphasizes that he was very young, so 可是 has a clear semantic turn.
